assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only azur-lane:taihou@mobile-game#azur-lane-taihou-character-monograph, the canonical frozen V1 integrated monograph AZUR_LANE_TAIHOU_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the pinned CN-semantic Azur Lane client corpus (build AZL-2026-08-22-4cca5c24-cc8e9fdf) as the monograph summarizes it: the seven-chapter dedicated memory dafeng1-dafeng7, 28 CN-linked narrative scenes with 257 direct dialogue lines, 116 normalized character-dialogue records, 25 CN social sections, 125 routed Dorm3D groups, and JP/EN/TW/KR regional textual witnesses. The R0-R3 specialist readings, the R5 adversarial audit, R6 relationship synthesis, R7 speech profile, R8 novel-situation audit, the claim-revision ledger and the extracted corpus are not curated on this subject; their results are used only as the monograph reports them, and probe protocols were not inspected. The project's readiness grade A, score 86.89 and simulator-status labels are inputs, not conclusions. The evaluator performed no primary-source inspection and no audio audition.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The live-service game has no single story chronology. The monograph's S0-S7 operating states are context states, and its CMD0-CMD3 Commander regimes are explicitly nonchronological; skins and Dorm3D are not forced into a sequence. The only ordered arc is the dafeng1-dafeng7 memory sequence, including the dafeng6-dafeng7 rest and self-condemnation episode. Claims cover the corpus pinned at the build above; content released after it, and the 58 unmapped audio records and four unresolved DormLvPerformance1201-1204 references, are outside the boundary.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: An explicit conditional decision system. A ten-step appraisal (section 3) feeds motives M1-M8 and states S0-S7. Its rules say what changes the response: Commander salience, relationship security, how the other person is classified, how legitimate and clear a competing constraint is, and who authored the frame (sections 4, 6, 9.2, 23). It predicts her overreach as well as her competence. She can name a boundary or her own excess and still override it (section 9.1, base 307070:feeling5; DORM3DVIDEO1201). Help can become self-authorizing access (DR3). A rival threat goes outward while a self-as-unwanted threat goes inward (section 5.2). Within the section 26 envelope it is a strong inferential model. Not A: severe thresholds are medium. The most consequential attachment edges are OPEN: acute serious refusal, serious rejection, betrayal and prolonged separation (sections 9.4, 26 C4). The validation audits behind the C2 and C3 classes are reported, not curated.

The dafeng1-dafeng7 memory sequence gives one ordered causal arc. The early rest sequence, in which care threatens her role, is set against secure reciprocal care in Dorm3D 12045 (section 15). Otherwise change is modelled as switching between context states and nonchronological Commander regimes (sections 6, 20). R3, which the monograph calls the longitudinal authority, is cross-context, not temporal. Not B: the evidence cannot say how she develops over time beyond the memory arc. Not D: the regime-dependent persistence of traits is specified, e.g. security that does not extinguish tracking (DR12).

Five independent locale textual systems are specified with their markers. CN, the semantic authority: frequent 大凤 self-reference, 指挥官大人/您, particles and tildes. JP: 大鳳, 指揮官様, ですわ/ますわ/くださいませ. EN: 'my Commander'. TW conserves the CN forms. KR: 다이호, 지휘관님 (section 22.1). Regional modifiers are quarantined, and the forbidden composite shortcut is named (section 22.2). The section 22.3 style ablation reports that identity rests on decisions, not markers. Not A: performed voice is OPEN_PARTIAL (151 slots mapped, 58 missing; section 22.4); speech for behaviourally OPEN states is excluded; full lines are seldom quoted.

Ordinary conduct is located at low Commander salience, with Juustagram posts 48, 135, 139 and 584, Yamashiro and Albacore scenes, and group decoration (section 18). Practical care is enumerated: food, clothing repair, bathing, weather preparation, massage, handmade tableware (section 15.1). Domestic routine in the high-security stratum is extensive (S6, CMD3). The anti-caricature rule that she can hold a mundane conversation without mentioning the Commander is evidence-backed (section 5.4). Not A: the breadth of her independent hobbies is medium, and domestic material is a high-security stratum that must not be projected onto baseline contexts (section 2).

The Commander relationship is modelled by regime (CMD0-CMD3) with a cross-regime acceptance-uncertainty overlay (section 20). Named peers have functional roles. Albacore is a disruptive familiar peer whose bond survives threat activation. Akagi is a rival whose competence is recognized, with negotiated three-person access. Shoukaku, Yamashiro, Roon and Yat Sen each have their own role (section 19). Section 26 reports a discriminating test: with Albacore's history held constant, harmless disruption and a credible threat cue produce different responses. Not A: Shoukaku, Yamashiro, Roon and Yat Sen are thinly sampled; long-duration shared access with Akagi is OPEN; strangers are limited.

Direct self-report exists in places: the dafeng7 self-condemnation, the meta-awareness of possible excess in DORM3DVIDEO1201, planning-fluster at 307075:feeling5 and admitted fatigue in 12045. The ten-step appraisal and goal weights are inferred from dialogue and action across contexts (sections 3, 5). Not B: there is no narrated inner life, and the appraisal steps are a model, not observed thought. Not D: the self-reports are located and discriminate between states.

Rivalry, threat and combat are separated by function. Rival threat brings claiming, comparison, monitoring, possible aggressive display and still-possible negotiation (DR6, S4). Seven functions of violent wording are classified before any literal reading (section 13), and Roon's escalation, which makes her uncomfortable, shows that the hyperbole is not literal (section 19.6). Defeat responses are heterogeneous and depend on what the loss threatens; minor failure can stay local (section 12; Dorm3D 12025). Not A: the ceiling on severe harm to an ordinary rival, and her response to grave professional failure, are OPEN.

Her ethically relevant conduct is modelled as norm recognition against norm weighting. She understands privacy, work legitimacy, operational authority and burden, and attachment reward can still outweigh them when closeness seems welcome (sections 9, 17). Located outcomes cover weak constraints, clear work interest, professional authority, established intimacy and self-as-unwanted states (section 9.2). Not B: there is no moral reasoning beyond this attachment-centred weighting; a broad moral or ideological worldview is unsupported (section 26 C5); acute serious refusal is OPEN. Not D: the weighting model is explicit and located.

Humour modes are listed: teasing, competitive exaggeration, erotic double meaning, theatrical threat hyperbole and ordinary peer banter, with the rule that not every joke is possessive or violent (section 18). Stage and gimmick theatre is classified as performance (section 13; jichang19). Self-authored playful or erotic staging is distinguished from deception (section 16). Not A: much of the play is short-form game text, and peer banter beyond Albacore is thin.

The monograph integrates an enumerated, pinned corpus. It includes a complete dedicated memory group, all 28 linked narrative scenes and the routed Dorm3D and social material. It declares exclusions: four unresolved performance references, regional alignment gaps (666 structural gaps in 2,541 candidates) and 58 missing audio records (sections 2, 22.1, 22.4). Not A: 79.3 percent of character dialogue is Commander-facing; the validation authorities behind its confidence classes are not curated on this subject; the evaluator inspected no source.

The evidence affirmatively excludes several readings. The pure possession, service-only and reassurance-only models each fail against located counterevidence (sections 8.2-8.5). Generalized manipulativeness outside Commander attachment is unsupported (section 16; Target H). Minor failure does not produce dafeng7-level shame (12025). Literal universal mutual indispensability was rejected at R5 (section 7, N5). Section 25 lists anti-caricature rules in both directions. Not A: several affirmative limits come from absent experiments rather than counterevidence, and the monograph labels them OPEN.

No story chronology is established. States and regimes are explicitly nonchronological, and skins are not a literal sequence (sections 2, 6, 20). Only the memory sequence is ordered, and claims are bounded only by the pinned build. Not C: no claim can be placed at a dated or sequenced point beyond the memory arc. Not E: the build pin and the nonchronological status are explicit, so misuse is guarded against.

conditions: Output is illustrative and labelled noncanonical, never presented as a quotation.
Appraisal and action are predicted first, inside the section 26 C1-C3 envelope; one locale (CN, JP, EN, TW or KR) is then chosen and only its documented markers and modifiers are applied.
Signature possessive or violent phrasing is not inserted where the state does not call for it.
No performed-voice, timbre or acoustic claim.
scenario_readiness.note: The five locale systems constrain illustrative wording once behaviour is fixed; the monograph forbids letting style repair an OPEN state.

conditions: One of the reported families: ordinary peer interaction at low Commander salience, work against desired proximity, self-authored performance, unexpected reciprocal agency (bounded), Akagi rivalry under secure choice with feasible local sharing, Albacore harmless disruption or credible threat, mild separation (bounded), credible reassurance, secure reciprocal care, tactical problem solving, theatrical violent language, an explicit operational or privacy boundary, small low-cost dependency engineering (bounded).
The Commander regime, security state and the other person's classification are named before prediction.

Abstain on acute serious refusal, serious Commander rejection, betrayal, prolonged unreassured separation, grave culpable failure, deliberate severe rival harm, long-duration enforced sharing, prolonged nonreciprocal dependency, non-Commander romance, broad moral conflict, permanent incapacity and loss of combat capability.
Exact outputs are C3 extrapolations, labelled as such.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: No story chronology; the pinned build AZL-2026-08-22-4cca5c24-cc8e9fdf, with the Commander at a named nonchronological regime (CMD0-CMD3) if present.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: The Commander at a named regime and security state, or Albacore, Akagi, Shoukaku, Yamashiro, Roon or Yat Sen in their documented functions, or an unfamiliar peer group with no Commander-threat cue.
setting_constraints: Port life, professional exercise or mission, public performance or event, private date, or established domestic setting.
Dorm3D-grounded behaviour only in high-security intimacy settings, never as a baseline.

scenario_readiness.note: Transfer is supported into the fourteen probe families section 26 reports as validated; the twelve forced-abstention controls are excluded.

conditions: Leisure, port life, group activity or practical conversation with a named peer or unfamiliar peer group.
No Commander references injected merely to make her recognizable (DR1).
Breadth of independent hobbies is not invented beyond the located examples.
scenario_readiness.note: Low-salience ordinary behaviour is directly evidenced and part of the reported validated envelope.

conditions: Predict how she weighs a legible privacy, work or authority norm against attachment reward, using the section 9.2 outcomes.
Awareness of excess is not treated as reliable restraint (DR10).
Abstain on acute serious refusal and on moral or ideological questions unrelated to attachment or role.
scenario_readiness.note: Only the attachment-centred weighting of privacy, autonomy, task and authority norms is supported.

conditions: The partner is the Commander at a named regime (CMD0-CMD3) and security state; the regimes are not a canon sequence.
Secure intimacy keeps tracking, access and exclusivity behaviour (DR12); self-authored frames raise fluency; an unexpected opening can fluster her.
No hard refusal, serious rejection, betrayal or prolonged separation, and no non-Commander romance.
scenario_readiness.note: The Commander romance is the most heavily evidenced domain, subject to the Commander-heavy composition warning and the OPEN high-stakes edges.

conditions: A legitimate, clearly structured task or exercise; she first seeks a task-plus-closeness solution, then restraint or compliance (DR2).
Competent participation under distributed authority and acceptance of peer expertise.
No broad command philosophy, no severe authority-versus-attachment conflict and no grave failure.
scenario_readiness.note: Task-legibility sensitivity is located and part of the reported validated envelope; leadership doctrine is not.

known_limits.statement: 79.3 percent of normalized character dialogue is Commander-facing; peer, public and low-salience evidence receives corrective weight, but global peer psychology rests on a smaller base.
Dorm3D is a high-security established-intimacy stratum and must not be projected onto baseline or stranger contexts.
Operating states and Commander regimes are nonchronological; skins are not a literal sequence, and only the memory arc is ordered.
The corpus has no clean, serious, informed hard-refusal experiment for intimacy or access; neither ignoring nor immediately honouring a serious no may be inferred.
Responses to serious Commander rejection, betrayal and long separation without reassurance are OPEN, and the exact severe self-as-unwanted threshold is medium.
Grave professional failure with responsibility, moral injury, and the ceiling of severe ordinary-world harm to a rival are OPEN.
Stable non-Commander romantic psychology, a broad moral or ideological worldview and comprehensive leadership style are unsupported.
JP performed voice is OPEN_PARTIAL_SOURCE_MAPPING (151 mapped slots, 58 expected records missing, 57 of them Dorm3D); text may not be used to fabricate acoustic traits.

The R5 adversarial audit and the R8 probes and abstention controls behind the C2 and C3 classes are reported in the monograph but are not curated evidence on this subject; their protocols and individual outcomes were not inspected.
